doing: changing whose a thing is
arguments:
  item: "The thing."
  owner: "Whose it is now: a person, a household or a group; nobody for no one's."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."

Changes whose a thing is, and nothing else: where it is and who has it stay as they are. Leave to use it that came from the old owner ends. The answer says what changed; given as a receipt, it leaves how the thing now stands to the file it names.
